reviews.text: Dr. Clive was so gentle and sweet with my kitty. They are very communicative and transparent with treatments and costs.

From the reception to the exam room, my Addie, Scotty  and AmeliaPenny are always cared for warmth, concern and kindness.
I highly recommend the entire team at Midtown Vet Hospital to everyone who seeks care for their furbabies

I am taking care of my son’s 14 year old pup- he’s a love but he’s old with some medical issues. He still is spry and gets around well - Midtown & Dr Clive have been the epitome the excellence regarding helping me through multiple trying moments. They give me good insights and recognize that quality is what we are going for in this case. I have appreciated their responsiveness & the caring people in the practice. This is my 3rd pet with them & they continue to be the best.

Caring professional staff. Gentle with my fur baby. Diagnosed condition, treated and recovery uneventful. Updated, relocated facility with much improved parking. I have taken Journey to them for six years.

My dog can’t wait to get inside to see Dr. Clive & his team. My 10-year old dog behaves calmly, doesn’t get antsy during exams or otherwise display any sign of discomfort with the humans. I love the practice because the techs are very helpful whether I’m phoning in or coming in for an appointment. Dr. Clive is great about explaining everything he observes or surmises after an exam. Sometimes he’ll follow up with suggestions for further reading if it’s a complicated issue. I always feel he takes a conservative approach while balancing it with awareness that my pet is priceless to me. In other words, I feel he puts the dog first rather than trying to make as much money as possible from the office visit. And finally, if my dog is being treated for an ailment, the staff always calls to check on how he’s doing.

I am newer to Houston and found this Vet through a chat gbt search for vets near me with high ratings. I just needed a wellness exam for my dog. The online booking was easy and efficient! I also got in right away which is not always the case.
The facility is new, super clean, I was seen right away upon entering, and attended to right away. The techs were amazing and loving, and the doctor was thorough. I loved that I paid inside the exam room, and did not have to pay outside in waiting room where there could be other animals. amazing experience!
Great experience, everyone was super friendly.  The Dr. was very thorough and even took the time to explain things in detail for me.  Definitely found my long term vet to care for my new Frenchie.

I had a fantastic experience at Midtown Veterinary Hospital! The team is incredibly professional, compassionate, and attentive. They took excellent care of my puppy, Toby, and made us feel welcome from the moment we walked in. I truly appreciate the high quality of care and the friendly atmosphere. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for a great vet in the area!☺️

I recently changed vets to see Dr. Clive and it was a really good decision.  My elderly cat received a very thorough exam and issues that had gone undiagnosed by my prior vet were discovered.  He and the tech, Taylor, were very gentle with my old man and took very good care of him.  We will definitely be staying with Midtown Vet Hospital.

Truly the best vet in Houston. Excellent bedside manner. One of my dogs is very nervous, and they will get down on the floor with him and pet him for a while before starting treatment and exams. They’re also very accommodating. I’ve referred a few friends and family members to them. 10/10!!!
The best team! Dr. Clive is so kind and helpful. The space is clean and organized. Glad to have them nearby.
We adopted a rescue and Dr. Clive and team took the time to answer all of our questions. Very kind - it really shows that they love animals. We know our new fur baby is in good hands.

I transferred my dog, Sassy's care over to Dr. Richard Clive many years ago as she was in boarding when she needed to be seen by a vet and I was out of town.  His care is exceptional as every visit Sassy is very anxious and needs a calming hand. The staff is great too!
Excellent clinic!!    Great staff and a wonderful, caring doctor!
Always caring for my pup like he was their own. Dr. Clive took great care in examining my pup & explaining everything to me.

Than you so much for taking care of my sweet Falafel!  The staff are always fantastic and the doctors explain things in a way I can understand.  Most important - my sweet Falafel is well cared for!  Thank you so much!
Everyone was very friendly, and the service was excellent!
We love Dr. Clive and the friendly staff!

Edit- my dog had a tooth abscess this week and the surgeon came in next day to treat him. She was wonderful too! Even though I live an hour away now, I will never leave this practice! They’re the best!

Dr. Clive is the best vet I’ve ever had. He always takes the time to explain his recommendations to me and he has fixed any health issue my dog has! Very fair pricing too and you can tell how much this place cares about animals.
My sweet Penny gets the best CARE and attention at Midtown.  She is thriving thanks to their discerning medical attention and follow up care.
Staff is always super friendly and helpful. Dr. Clive is comprehensive and knowledgeable. I know my pets are in excellent hands here.
Dr. Clive and Morgan examined my aging pup this week and it was the most thorough exam he has ever had!  They are amazing!!

I have gone to Dr. Clive for 11 years now with two different dogs and still go to him even though I live a little further away now because him and his staff are so great. They treat the animals with such kindness and respect, and I like how they help me work through my options when my dog needs care. There are new location has more parking now, which is great too!
Very polite and welcoming staff members! Patient with all the questions I had & made sure I understood the whole process! Affordable and would highly recommend!
Always friendly and helpful!!
Best veterinarian office in Houston!!

Dr. Harberson is the best! She truly cares about your pet/her patients and always goes above and beyond. I always know our cats are in the best hands with her. The receptionists are friendly and easy to get in touch with. We love Midtown Vet!
Amazing staff! Always happy to help! and Dr. Clive always answers all my questions and thoroughly examines my dog!
Teddy and Milo love Dr Clive!

We used to love this vet until one of our cats died during a dental cleaning last week. She was 7 and had no underlying conditions and she died due to an issue with the equipment because the team was not properly monitoring it. As horrible as her death has been to process, how the team handled everything after her death has made the healing process much harder.

When we arrived to see her the staff were tip toeing around us and it seemed like they were afraid of us. The vet explained what happened and kept going on about how this has never happened to her before and that they would set all of the equipment aside to check it before doing more cleanings. I felt like the vet was looking for us to comfort or forgive her rather than focusing on what we needed in that moment. I understand that there is a risk with any procedure, but it was harder to hear that this that it was just our cat who died due to an issue that should have never happened. It makes us feel like we failed her by putting our trust in this team.

The office then stopped contact with us, which meant we had to call them the next week to get information on when we can expect the medical records and her ashes. They said they thought we wouldn’t want to hear from them. Which they are right, it isn’t easy to hear from them but ignoring us and making us follow-up was much worse.
Dr. Clive and all the doctors and techs are amazing!! They are so friendly, helpful and gentle with our pets ☺️

All of the staff are so nice and kind and understanding. Dr Clive is so thorough and smart, he has taken great care of my sweet, little Chubbs and I feel confident in the care he gets when we have to visit.
The Midtown veterinary team is excellent and efficient. Highly recommend!

I've been going here since 2015 with my first cat. They are always respectful and handled her with care. Maybe it may be a little more expensive than other vet clinics, but the experience and expertise makes it worth it. I love Dr. Lang and Dr. Clive.
The service is wonderful, the staff is friendly, they speak both English and Spanish, and they explain the procedures they perform very well.
Dr Clive and staff are wonderful! Alexandra was warm and informative, and Dr Clive is always so thorough and gentle!
Dr Klive and the gang at Midtown are always wonderful with my fur baby
We've trusted the friendly, expert care at Midtown Vet for more than 11 years now, since Houston was a puppy.  We couldn't be happier and recommend them without reservation.
Everyone here has continually gone out of their way to take immediate and effective care of our beloved pet, and we are so grateful.
Absolutely, A 5 STAR clinic usually when you go to vet clinics staff are rude these lady’s were awesome and especially the Dr. my cat was well taken care of. 🙏🏻 DEFINITELY COME HERE !
Thanks to Midtown vet! Dr Clive you’re terrific. Always caring staff, I recommend this vet for your dogs care…6 years using them!

They take such good care of my babies. I really love this place. Everyone here is very friendly and nice.. But not in a regular way it feels like I’m amongst family. They are very honest which I appreciate and I really respect their pricing. My cat had an emergency and I brought her there and they took it very seriously they didn’t make me wait like most places were trying to get me to wait for her life-threatening emergency and I can’t thank them enough for saving my cats life. Also whenever I have any issues with my dog or a cat, I call them and they know exactly what to do. They even instruct me how to be preventative and they give me a resources on how to manage The best health for my pet. They really pay attention to your pets needs and the doctor is super knowledgeable and sweet. I should have wrote this review ages ago, but I went in for preventative treatment today for my pets and I was reminded of how kind and responsible the staff is. If you are looking for a trustworthy place, I truly recommend this place. If you really love your pets and spoil them like your own kids I’d recommend this place.lol
Dr Clive is great and the staff is so friendly
Amazing team that takes excellent care of my dog. They genuinely care about their pet clients and owners. Always a positive experience!
Best Vet in Houston! Dr. Clive is very knowledgeable and treats my Dolly as if she were his own. I am delighted.
Friendly staff and a great doctor providing quality care to my pets for over a decade.

We have been taking our dogs Zane and Roxy to Dr Clive for over a decade and I know he cares so much about our pets. He  is very communicative and takes the time to answer any questions as well as providing options for care. We can’t imagine taking our pets anywhere else.
Vet and vet techs were very attentive and kind. They listened to my questions and concerns and treated me and my kitty very well!

I’ve been bringing Hugo to Midtown Veterinary Hospital for about a year, after several years with Banfield at PetSmart. Banfield was cost-effective, but it always felt as if something was missing. Midtown fills that gap—and then some.

What I Love
(1) Highly trained staff: Everyone I’ve met clearly studied animal care and it shows in the way they handle exams and explain treatments.

(2) Expert yet humble doctors: When the team isn’t 100 % sure, they say so, consult their network, and come back with a well-researched answer. That honesty builds trust.

(3) Quality experience: From the spotless facility to the calm, confident way they handle my working-breed dog, everything feels top tier.

(4) Efficient visits: I’m in and out quickly, and although I’ve read parking can be tricky, I’ve never had an issue.

(5) Transparent pricing: Every procedure comes with an upfront estimate and clear explanations of any potential add-ons—no surprises.

What Could Be Better
Midtown is slightly more expensive than some other clinics—but honestly, it’s not that much more. Still, it’s worth mentioning. You’re paying for a knowledgeable, well-trained staff, a clean and efficient facility, and a level of care that feels more personalized and professional.

And let’s be real—if you truly love your furry friend, you probably won’t mind spending a little extra to make sure they’re getting top-tier care. Think of it like upgrading from coach to first class... except your dog gets the window seat. 🐶✈️

The best part? There are no surprise charges. They give you an estimate up front, explain everything clearly, and let you approve it before moving forward. It’s straightforward, transparent, and reassuring.

All in all, Midtown Vet delivers the kind of care that makes you feel good walking in—and even better walking out, knowing your pet is in the best hands.

I’ve been taking my cats to Midtown for about 6 years and before that, Dr. Clive helped with my 2 geriatric cats through stomach cancer and kidney disease until they lived to 18 years old of age. All the vets and staff at Midtown have been more than supportive. I would recommend the pet owners to take their babies to this veterinarian clinic.
The staff was amazing. Took my dog for a check-up for his travel certificate, and the entire staff was friendly.  Dr. Clive explained everything my dog needed.Will definitely go back.
Needed to get care for my pup while in town for two months and they were able to get me in right away to address my concerns.  Treated with respect, and positive environment.
We are so grateful for Drs. Clive and Harberson, and the wonderful group of vet techs. We get trusted, dependable, humane car for our animals. Thank you Midtown Vet!!

I love Dr. Clive. He always takes special care and attention with my best pal, and he makes sure all of my questions are answered. The vet techs are also all very attentive sweet to my dog. I can't imagine going to another vet.

Friendly and caring service.

Updated to once again reinforce the caring and compassionate care of this office and staff.

We are so grateful for Dr. Clive and the entire team at Midtown Veterinary. Our dog Luca is family to us, and knowing he’s in such capable and caring hands brings us incredible peace of mind.

Dr. Clive is not only highly skilled and knowledgeable, but he also has a calm, compassionate presence that immediately puts both pets and their owners at ease. He took the time to explain every step of Luca’s care, answered all our questions thoroughly, and treated Luca as if he were his own dog. It’s clear that he truly cares about the animals he treats.

Whether it’s a routine check-up or a more serious issue, we’ve always felt supported, informed, and respected. The entire staff at Midtown Veterinary is professional, friendly, and clearly passionate about what they do.

Thanks to Dr. Clive, Luca is happy, healthy, and thriving—and we wouldn’t trust anyone else with his care. If you’re looking for a veterinarian who goes above and beyond, Dr. Clive is the one.
I love Midtown Vet! Both Doctors are awesome! And I can tell they truly care about my 2 dogs.

I cannot thank this veterinary team enough for the care they gave my dog during a really stressful and emotional situation. From the moment we walked in, they were incredibly kind, patient, and thorough. They took the time to explain everything to me — not just what was happening, but why, and how we were going to treat it step by step.

Even though I was worried and overwhelmed, they helped me feel confident in the plan, and my dog felt safe and comforted throughout the visit. They didn’t just treat a skin infection — they treated us like family. I’m so grateful for their compassion, professionalism, and the way they truly care about their patients.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for a vet who goes above and beyond.

I’ve been taking my dog and 2 cats here for a few years. The vets are amazing, the techs are amazing, everyone there I have ever interacted with was amazing.

I also take my dog Margaret and my other cat Genevieve there for their year check ups or if there’s anything strange with them. They always get the best treatment.

Pics of my happy and healthy chunky girls!

Dr. Clive is knowledgeable, compassionate and very patient. Importantly he has great helpers who are managing details of the pra rice with great skill, memory and understanding.
Love the practice as a whole!
They did a great job treating my cat. everyone is so friendly

Midtown is such a unique veterinary clinic. I always feel welcomed and heard. All of the staff is friendly and professional. I truly feel that they are sincere in their actions and they are compassionate about taking care of pets.

Our doctors were friendly, knowledgeable, and transparent. It's clear that this place and everyone who works here LOVES animals. They are communicative and don't immediately jump to expensive medications for every problem.

We have taken our kitties to Midtown for the past 5 years and are so thankful to have such kind and compassionate vets. Everything is always thoroughly explained and follow up is fantastic. You can tell the staff genuinely care and everyone is always so sweet when we have to come in.

Thank you for helping me with the certificate!
the best place to take your pets. everyone is very kind and patient and i’m always assured we are getting the best care!
